title: Introduce HSM migration planner and SealedSecret quarantine adapter for safer TLS key cutovers
author: Daniel Kim
description:
Motivation: On private deployments we need a safer, auditable path for migrating customer keys between HSMs and for performing TLS certificate/key cutovers that cannot rely on instantaneous key promotion. This PR implements two coordinated pieces: (1) an HSM migration planner (a CLI + controller) that computes and schedules an ordered set of steps for key export/import, envelope rewraps, and staged promotion with automatic preflight checks; (2) a SealedSecret quarantine adapter that provides a quarantined copy of incoming sealed secrets used for key rotation so operators can validate decryption/re-encryption and run live canaries before committing the new secrets to production namespaces.

What this changes: combined changes across Terraform modules, Helm charts, and a small controller binary: - terraform/modules/hsm: dependency graph, idempotent staging bucket, lifecycle hooks for staged import jobs - helm/charts/private-installer/templates/migration-job.yaml: new Job template driven by Planner CR - helm/charts/private-installer/values.yaml: migration feature flags, quarantine annotations - k8s/controllers/sealedsecret-quarantine: new controller to create quarantined SealedSecrets in an isolated namespace and run rewrap probes - tools/hsm-planner: CLI to generate migration plans, export dry-run manifests, and emit a JSON plan used by the controller - examples/migration/README.md: walkthrough for staged cutovers - test/upgrade/fixtures: small integration fixtures used in CI

Checklist:
- [x] Planner CLI: plan generation, dry-run, idempotent run mode
- [x] Planner controller: create/patch Kubernetes Job for each plan step, mark step success/failure
- [x] Quarantine adapter: transparently create quarantined sealed secrets and expose probe status via annotation
- [x] Terraform: add hsm_resource dependency and S3 staging bucket with KMS encryption
- [x] Helm: feature gate, RBAC rules for migration jobs, and new chart values
- [x] E2E smoke: integration tests in CI against a lightweight k8s cluster
- [x] Documentation: examples and operator runbook

Rollback/Failure modes: The planner produces an explicit reversal plan for each step. The controller supports 'pause-on-failure' so human operators can inspect quarantined secrets before continuing. The quarantine adapter never writes to production namespaces until operator explicitly approves a plan result.

Security notes: All staging buckets and interim artifacts are encrypted with the target HSM wrap keys when available; the Terraform changes also enforce least-privilege IAM for the temporary import role. Audit records are emitted to the platform audit log with plan IDs.

How to test locally: follow examples/migration/README.md. Key commands: ./tools/hsm-planner plan --from-hsm=alpha --to-hsm=beta --certificate cert.pem --output=plan.json and kubectl apply -f examples/migration/dryrun.yaml. CI runs a smoke migration on an ephemeral cluster (see test/upgrade/pipeline).

review_comments: Elena Kovács: Please add an explicit assertion that the quarantine adapter never copies secrets into production namespaces without a plan approval — I want this to be auditable.
Daniel Kim (author): Added plan approval annotation and audit log event emission in controller; updated runbook with exact kubectl commands and audit examples.
Marcus Li: Request to add automated rollback unit for partial rewrap failures so we can revert intermediate objects. Also, can we limit the S3 staging bucket lifetime for ephemeral artifacts?
Daniel Kim (author): Implemented reversal plan generation and TTL lifecycle policy for the staging bucket in Terraform; added tests for reversal behavior.
Priya Reddy: LGTm overall; left a minor comment about RBAC scope for the migration job serviceAccount. Can we narrow the role to only create Jobs and read ConfigMaps?
Daniel Kim (author): Narrowed RBAC and documented the minimum privileges in values.yaml.
release_notes: Adds HSM migration planner and SealedSecret quarantine adapter to support staged TLS/key cutovers in private deployments. Includes Terraform and Helm updates to enable migration workflows and a runbook for operators.
additional_context: Rationale: reduces blast radius for cross-HSM key rotations and provides clear operator-controlled gates.
Follow-ups: integrate with rotation-coordinator UI to visualize plan steps (ENG-3378).
Testing note: CI smoke runs are intentionally conservative (single-cert, short TTL) to avoid HSM test quotas.
